leaf(name: string) -> NODE => NODE(name, LIST[NODE]())

render_nest(node: NODE, depth: int) -> Pipe[string] is

render_indent(lines: List[LINE]) -> Pipe[string] =>
    lines |> map(line => "{line.depth} {line.name}")

to_indent(node: NODE, depth: int) -> Pipe[LINE] is
    yield (depth = depth, name = node.name)

    for child in node.children do

to_nest(lines: List[LINE], position: int) -> (node: NODE, next: int) is
    let head = lines[position]
    let children = LIST[NODE]()
    let cursor mut = position + 1

    while cursor < lines.count /\ lines[cursor].depth > head.depth do

    od

let start =
    NODE("RosettaCode",
         [NODE("rocks", [leaf("code"), leaf("comparison"), leaf("wiki")]),
          NODE("mocks", [leaf("trolling")])])

write_line("nest form:")

render_nest(start, 0) |> each(line => write_line(line))

let indented = to_indent(start, 0) |> collect()

write_line()
write_line("indent form:")

render_indent(indented) |> each(line => write_line(line))

let (rebuilt, _) = to_nest(indented, 0)

write_line()
write_line("nest form, rebuilt from the indent form:")

render_nest(rebuilt, 0) |> each(line => write_line(line))

let before = render_nest(start, 0) |> join("\n")
let after = render_nest(rebuilt, 0) |> join("\n")

write_line()
write_line("round trip preserved the tree: {before =~ after}")
